channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Governo quer controlar venda de mineradoras, diz Silveira
item.description: Mines and Energy Minister Alexandre Silveira announced the federal government seeks to approve PL 2780/2024 to gain authority to veto or approve changes in shareholder control of mining companies, aiming to protect national sovereignty over strategic resources. The measure, already passed by the Chamber of Deputies, awaits Senate vote and includes the creation of the National Plan for Critical and Strategic Minerals and the National Mineral Policy Council.

item.title: Integrantes do PL do Rio presisonam pela escolha de nome ao Senado
item.description: Members of the PL in Rio de Janeiro are urging a quick decision on the party's Senate candidate, as the national convention is set for March 25. Following the withdrawal of Cláudio Castro, the choice between Senator Carlos Portinho and Federal Deputy Carlos Jordy has become urgent, given the need to build voter recognition quickly. The arrest of Márcio Canella (União Brasil), expected to be the right-wing alliance's second candidate, intensifies pressure on the PL to finalize its nominee.

item.title: Crusoé: “Prometeram picanha. Entregaram churrasquinho de gato”
item.description: Former Bolsonaro economy ministry aide Daniella Marques criticized the Lula government, saying it promised 'picanha' (substantial economic benefits) but delivered only 'churrasquinho de gato' (meager or unsatisfactory results). She claimed the government has spent nearly the equivalent of a pandemic on re-election efforts, and the cost will be high for Brazilians.

item.title: Crusoé: Alopragem eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) campaign faces new strain with female voters after a public clash with Michelle Bolsonaro, the PL's leading female figure and a central bolsonarist figure. The internal conflict threatens to weaken the senator's pre-candidacy, which already struggles to expand beyond its traditional base. The situation highlights risks of fragmentation within the conservative camp ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Depoimento de Flávio à PF ganha tom político, e defesa aposta em comparação com caso Lulinha
item.description: Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Federal Police to hear Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in an inquiry over alleged slander against President Lula, following a request from the PGR. The defense aims to turn the hearing into a political confrontation, contrasting the speed of this investigation with the slow progress in the INSS fraud case involving Lulinha, claiming unequal treatment. Political analysts say judicialization will be a central feature of the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Câmara oficializa troca de deputados após decisão da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies officially replaced deputies Paulão (PT-AL) and Dayany Bittencourt (União Brasil-CE) following Electoral Justice decisions that altered the seat distribution from the 2022 elections. The measure was published in an extra edition of the Chamber’s Official Gazette on Thursday (9), complying with judicial rulings related to the electoral process.

item.title: Caiado critica Lula e Flávio pelo tarifaço: “Farinha do mesmo saco”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for president, accused Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of being 'from the same sack' for prioritizing personal interests over Brazil's amid the proposed 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods. Caiado claimed Lula takes no action to defend Brazil and seeks to benefit from the conflict with the U.S., while Flávio tries to distance himself from the Bolsonaro family's image of supporting U.S. sanctions, focusing only on his own election. The criticism follows the start of U.S. public hearings, with a final decision expected by July 15.

item.title: Críticas a Flávio fazem Caiado ser o terceiro presidenciável mais citado nas redes
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado became the third-most-mentioned presidential candidate on social media after intensifying criticism against Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Brandwatch monitoring from June 1 to July 9. He surpassed Romeu Zema and Renan Santos in volume and reach, peaking at 21,237 mentions and 42.2 million impressions on July 7, due to a harder stance in the right-wing leadership race.

item.title: Prefeiro ‘tiktoker’ de Sorocaba é alvo de pedido de expulsão do Republicanos
item.description: Sorocaba's mayor Rodrigo Manga, nicknamed the 'TikTok mayor', faces an expulsion request from his party, Republicanos, for publicly supporting his wife's federal congressional pre-candidacy, despite her being affiliated with União Brasil. The request, filed by a former councilman, cites a breach of party loyalty. Manga, who was temporarily removed from office last year over Federal Police suspicions of public health fund embezzlement, insists he will continue backing his wife due to personal loyalty and shared policy priorities, including health, infrastructure, and security.

item.title: Vini Jr. pede desculpas à torcida brasileira por eliminação na Copa do Mundo
item.description: Vinícius Júnior apologized to Brazilian fans for the national team's elimination in the Round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup following a loss to Norway. He scored four goals and provided one assist in the tournament and vowed to fight to return Brazil to the top of world football. Coach Carlo Ancelotti had his contract extended until 2030, and coordinator Rodrigo Caetano reaffirmed his confidence in the Italian manager.

item.title: Nova cartada de Michelle Bolsonaro amplia incerteza sobre futuro político
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro launched the 'Imparáveis' movement after stepping down as head of PL Mulher, aiming to preserve her political capital and maintain influence independently of internal Bolsonaro family disputes. The movement expands her operational scope beyond the PL, allowing her to await political clarity without direct ties to Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign. Her electoral future, including a potential Senate run in the DF, remains undefined, according to political scientist Rafael Cortez.

item.title: O ‘número mágico’ que os bolsonaristas estimam que daria vitória contra Lula
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro believe he can defeat Lula in 2026 if he reaches the runoff with a deficit of up to five points, arguing that anti-PT sentiment and center-right support would reverse the outcome. Despite crises including an audio with banker Vorcaro, criticism from Michelle Bolsonaro, and PF operations, he remains Lula’s main rival, trailing by four points in the runoff per Datafolha (43% vs 47%) and ten points in the first round. The Atlas Bloomberg poll shows a similar trend: a six-point deficit in the runoff (48.8% vs 42.3%) and ten points in the first round.

item.title: Operadora de esquema de emendas de Valdemar, 'Tuca' foi alvo da PF em dezembro
item.description: Public servant Mariângela Fialek, known as Tuca, was targeted by the Federal Police in December for allegedly operating a scheme of parliamentary amendment diversion attributed to Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL. She served as an aide to Arthur Lira in the Chamber of Deputados from 2021 to mid-2025 and, according to the PF, controlled diverted indications from the 'secret budget' benefiting a suspected criminal organization. Minister Flávio Dino of the STF emphasized evidence that Tuca acted as Valdemar's 'longa manus,' supporting the asset freeze of R$ 119 million against him for embezzlement of amendments.

item.title: Lula diz que Brasil saiu da Copa porque jogadores "não se conversavam"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva blamed Brazil's elimination from the 2026 World Cup on poor communication among players and criticized the hiring of personal photographers by athletes during the tournament. He said the team failed to talk enough to focus on defeating opponents. Brazil was eliminated by Norway in the round of 16, marking its worst performance in 60 years.

item.title: Trump tem inveja do conhecimento chinês sobre terras-raras, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said Donald Trump is envious of China's knowledge of rare earths and suggested Brazil could surpass China in critical minerals. Lula emphasized Brazil's potential and stated the country aims to be an exporter of intelligence, not just raw materials. The remarks were made during a ministerial meeting at the Palácio do Planalto to discuss Brazil's strategy for critical minerals.

item.title: Ao falar de minerais críticos, Lula diz que Trump tem inveja da China
item.description: President Lula claims Donald Trump is envious of China's dominance in critical minerals, stating Brazil could become a competitor due to its second-largest global reserves of rare earths. He emphasizes the need for a national policy to move up the value chain, exporting intelligence and knowledge rather than raw materials, to achieve technological and industrial sovereignty.

item.title: ‘Imparáveis’: o que é o movimento lançado por Michelle Bolsonaro após sair do PL Mulher
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro launched the 'Imparáveis' movement after stepping down as head of PL Mulher, declaring she will not stop and aiming to unite conservative, right-leaning women and men. Initially planned for 2027, the movement was accelerated due to power struggles with Flávio Bolsonaro and now operates via a new Instagram profile, focusing on mobilization without seeking to replace PL Mulher or create a new party.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump tem 'inveja' da China na área de minerais críticos
item.description: President Lula stated that Donald Trump is 'envious' of China's leadership in critical minerals, during a meeting at the Palácio do Planalto. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves (21 million tonnes) and aims to raise its share of global critical minerals production from 8.3% to 12.2% by 2050 under the National Mining Plan 2050. The remarks come amid Itamaraty negotiations with the U.S. to avoid new tariffs on Brazilian goods, while the U.S. seeks an agreement to explore critical minerals exploration of minerals in Brazil.

item.title: PP e União Brasil não devem apoiar Flávio Bolsonaro nas eleições presidenciais
item.description: The federation formed by the União Brasil and Progressistas (PP) parties is not expected to support the presidential pre-candidacy of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in 2026. The decision stems from growing tensions, particularly due to Bolsonaro's lack of public support during key incidents, such as the arrest of Márcio Canella and the investigation into PP leader Ciro Nogueira. As a result, state-level directories will have autonomy to back candidates based on local considerations.

item.title: Em agenda no Rio, Caiado promete ‘alforriar’ favelas
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD’s pre-candidate for president, stated that if elected, he will 'liberate' favelas dominated by organized crime in Rio de Janeiro, promising to free communities from drug trafficking through strict security measures. He reinforced his hardline security stance, a key pillar of his campaign, and announced support for Eduardo Paes’s reelection bid, an ally of President Lula. Caiado is running alongside Gilberto Kassab, PSD president, as his vice-presidential pick in a ticket described as 'pure blood'.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da decisão que bloqueou emendas ligadas a Valdemar
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the blocking of R$119 million belonging to Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, on suspicion of operationalizing parliamentary amendments without holding a mandate in the Chamber of Deputies. The decision is based on a Federal Police report indicating that Chamber officials were suspected of coordinating the funds at Valdemar’s direction.

item.title: Entenda esquema com emendas que levou a bloqueio de contas de Valdemar
item.description: The Federal Police found that Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, exercised a 'personal and particular quota' to decide the allocation of parliamentary amendments, despite holding no office in the Chamber of Deputies, having directed at least 21 amendments totaling R$ 119 million. This practice, deemed irregular by the PF, aimed to give the appearance of legality to the diversion of public funds, constituting a potential crime of embezzlement. Consequently, Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino blocked Valdemar’s accounts up to the amount of the amendments and suspended their execution, as part of the ongoing Operation Transparency investigation.

item.title: Trump cesa a los demócratas en la Comisión de Asistencia Electoral de Estados Unidos
item.description: Donald Trump fired two Democratic members of the U.S. bipartisan Election Assistance Commission, ten days after a Supreme Court ruling granted him broad authority to dismiss officials in independent federal agencies. A third Republican official resigned. The move comes just four months ahead of pivotal midterm elections and as Trump pushes for an electoral reform critics say would restrict voting rights in practice.

item.title: Em pré-campanha, Renan Santos lança álbum e faz show em SP
item.description: Renan Santos, a presidential pre-candidate for the Mission party, launched his debut musical album 'Chão Pintado de Rubi' and performed with his band Limão Rosa at Bar Alto in São Paulo. The band, which includes former state deputy Arthur do Val on drums, gained visibility in March by leading the public voting phase of a contest by 89 FM, though they did not advance to Lollapalooza. The album is now available on streaming platforms.

item.title: Comandante do Exército escolhe militar para auxiliar TSE por até 23 meses
item.description: The Commander of the Army, General Tomás Paiva, appointed Sub-Lieutenant Edimilson Pereira Caniato, from the military matériel corps, to assist the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) for up to 23 months. The appointment responds to a request from TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who asked the Ministry of Defense to designate an Army soldier to serve as an assistant in the Electoral Court.

item.title: "Valdemar pediu pra trocar": leia mensagens citadas em decisão de Dino
item.description: Messages analyzed by the Federal Police, including 'Valdemar asked to swap' and 'Valdemar's amendments', were cited by Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino in a decision that advanced the investigation and froze R$119.2 million in assets of Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party. The dialogues, extracted from a public servant’s phone, suggest he acted as a mandatary in directing parliamentary amendments, influencing public fund allocation without holding elected office. The PF indicates evidence of illegal conduct in the allocation of public funds.

item.title: Torcida pede Jorge Jesus na Seleção Brasileira após crítica a Neymar
item.description: Jorge Jesus' criticism of Neymar during his presentation as Portugal's head coach sparked reactions on social media, with Brazilian fans arguing he would be a better coach for the Brazil national team than Carlo Ancelotti. They praise his tactical style, winning mentality, and authoritative presence, believing he would not have allowed the humiliating World Cup exit under Ancelotti's leadership.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio cobram mudanças na pré-campanha após sequência de desgastes
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro are demanding changes in his presidential pre-campaign following a series of controversies, including allegations of financial negotiations with banker Daniel Vorcaro and rumors of a compromising video. Influencer Paulo Figueiredo denounced individuals spreading false proximity claims as damaging to the campaign, while former Communications Secretary Fabio Wajngarten publicly urged PL leader Valdemar Costa Neto to overhaul the campaign’s leadership, proposing Marcelão, Duda Lima, and Walter Longo for key roles.

item.title: “Fechou o valor do presidente Valdemar?”
item.description: STF Minister Flávio Dino cited dialogues between Arthur Lira's former parliamentary aide, Mariângela Fialek (Tuca), and Garigham Amarante Pinto, a lawyer with a special role in Jair Bolsonaro's PL leadership, as key evidence that Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, exerted direct influence over party decisions. The conversations suggest political articulations involving private interests, possibly tied to financial or power agreements. The headline question — 'Did they settle Valdemar's price?' — implies a suspicion of negotiation or payment in exchange for political favors.

item.title: Silvio Costa Filho diz que Republicanos vai apoiar Lula em Pernambuco
item.description: Silvio Costa Filho, president of the Republicans party in Pernambuco, stated that the party will support Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election in the state, regardless of the National Executive's decision. He also confirmed support for João Campos (PSB) as gubernatorial candidate, emphasizing that the party's stance in Pernambuco follows its historical alignment with Lula.

item.title: Por soberania, Lula reúne ministros em discussão de minerais críticos
item.description: President Lula convened ministers, mining sector representatives, and specialists to discuss a national policy on critical minerals, emphasizing sovereignty and full control over the processing chain. The meeting included Vice President Alckmin and ministers from Casa Civil, Foreign Affairs, Finance, Development, Mines and Energy, among others, as well as executives from Vale and BNDES and academics from USP and UFABC. The discussion takes place as Congress reviews the 'Rare Earths Bill,' already approved in the Chamber of Deputies and stalled in the Senate.

item.title: “Farinha do mesmo saco”, diz Caiado sobre Lula e Flávio
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) harshly criticized President Lula and federal deputy Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), stating they are 'cut from the same cloth'. The remarks were made in a video published by the pré-candidate for the 2026 presidency, intensifying his attacks on the leading contenders in current opinion polls.

item.title: Maranhão: Braide fecha chapa para o Senado com Lahésio Bonfim e Fufuca
item.description: Eduardo Braide, the PSD pre-candidate for governor of Maranhão, announced Lahésio Bonfim (Novo) as his Senate running mate, alongside André Fufuca (PP), forming an opposition ticket in the state. Braide leads polls with 44% voter intention, ahead of Orleans Brandão at 31%, and has rejected PT alliances, which responded by nominating Felipe Camarão. Although lacking Flávio Bolsonaro's support, Bonfim's selection aligns Braide with the bolsonarist camp in Maranhão.

item.title: Renan Santos chama Flávio de "criminoso" e não entende candidatura
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential pre-candidate, labeled Flávio Bolsonaro a 'criminal' and questioned his motivation for running, stating he 'never wanted to be president' and is only in Brasília to make business deals and buy real estate. Santos also criticized the Novo party for aligning with Bolsonarism despite presenting itself as a centrist alternative.

item.title: Eleições das desilusões e rejeições (por Antônio Carlos de Medeiros)
item.description: The 2026 elections will be defined by widespread voter disillusionment and rejection, with a potential record abstention, blank, and null vote rate reaching up to 56%. Rejections of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro hover around 50% each, reflecting fatigue with polarization and deep distrust in politics, particularly among independents and those opting for the 'lesser evil' vote.

item.title: Michelle antecipa lançamento de novo perfil nas redes para mobilizar apoiadores diante de embate com Flávio e saída do PL Mulher
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro accelerated the launch of her 'Imparáveis' social media profile to mobilize supporters after stepping down from PL Mulher leadership and amid a conflict with her stepson, Flávio Bolsonaro. Inspired by Sia's 'Unstoppable' and using Wonder Woman imagery, the profile aims to sustain her network of conservative women and foster new female leadership. The move was prompted by internal party turmoil and the loss of the PL’s official communication channels.

item.title: TSE cria programa para que pessoas com deficiência tenham transporte gratuito para ir votar
item.description: The TSE has launched the 'Your Vote Matters' program, providing free transportation to voters with disabilities or reduced mobility for the October elections. Requests must be submitted up to 20 days before election day, via self-declaration or documentation, and will be implemented by state electoral courts (TREs) in cooperation with state Justice Tribunals, with no direct budgetary impact.

item.title: Por Dentro das Eleições: conheça os ilícitos eleitorais e as condutas proibidas no pleito de 2026
item.description: The TSE Resolution No. 23.757/2026 defines and prohibits illicit practices in the 2026 elections, including vote buying, abuse of power, misuse of public and private resources, gender quota fraud, disinformation, and use of artificial intelligence to manipulate voters. The norm aims to ensure equality, freedom, and legitimacy of the vote, establishing sanctions for public officials and private individuals who violate the rules.

item.title: Por que deputados perderam o mandato quase 4 anos depois das eleições?
item.description: Federal deputies Paulão (PT-AL) and Dayany Bittencourt (União-CE) lost their mandates in the Chamber of Deputados due to a vote recount ordered by Brazil's Electoral Justice. The change followed the annulment of votes for their party's substitutes due to campaign finance violations: João Catunda (PP-AL) was invalidated for illicitly using health union funds, and Heitor Freire (União-CE) for misusing the Electoral Fund. The revised vote count recalculated the electoral quotient and seat distribution, resulting in the loss of the deputies' original seats.

item.title: Saiba quem são os deputados que assumem vagas na Câmara com as perdas dos mandatos de Paulão e Dayany Bittencourt
item.description: Nivaldo Albuquerque (Republicanos-AL) and Priscila Costa (PL-CE) assumed seats in the Chamber of Deputies following the loss of mandates by Paulão (PT-AL) and Dayany Bittencourt (União-CE), respectively. The changes resulted from vote retotalization after electoral court annulments: Paulão lost his seat due to the annulment of votes for João Catunda (PP-AL) over illicit vote buying, while Dayany lost hers due to the annulment of votes for Heitor Freire (União-CE) for illicit campaign spending using public election funds.

item.title: Ato de Mesa da Câmara rende mandato à pivô de ‘treta’ entre Flávio e Michelle
item.description: The loss of mandate of deputy Dayany Bittencourt by the Chamber's Directive Board led to the inauguration of Priscila Costa, identified as a pivot in the conflict between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro. Michelle supports Priscila as a Senate candidate in 2026, while Flávio’s faction prefers state deputy Alcides Fernandes. The decision follows a process initiated by the Chamber’s Corregedor after the annulment of votes by the TRE of Ceará in 2022.

item.title: Lula reúne ministros para tratar de minerais críticos em meio a negociações com EUA sobre tarifaço
item.description: President Lula convenes ministers to discuss critical minerals management in Brazil amid negotiations with the U.S. over tariffs and exploration agreements. Brazil holds the world's second-largest rare earth reserves (21 million tons) and aims to increase its global critical minerals production share from 8.3% to 12.2% by 2050, with the imminent release of the National Mining Plan 2050.

item.title: “Estamos mais organizados do que em 2018”, diz Chorão sobre greve dos caminhoneiros
item.description: Wallace Landim (Chorão), president of the Brazilian Association of Motor Vehicle Drivers (Abrava), says truckers are more organized than in 2018 and threatens a strike if the Freight Floor Provisional Measure (MP nº 1.343/2026) is not approved by the Senate by July 16. He blames Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for delaying the vote due to political motives following a clash with the government over the nomination of Jorge Messias to the STF, and states that 60% of the category would support a strike.

item.title: Damares cobra explicações sobre atuação da PF em protestos contra Lula
item.description: Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) requested explanations from the Ministry of Justice regarding the Federal Police's actions in investigations linked to protests against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during official agendas. The request follows reports indicating the PF expanded occurrence records and opened inquiries in anti-government demonstrations. Damares alleges potential political use of the institution to target opponents.

item.title: Ceará: pivô de crise, aliada de Michelle afaga Flávio antes de evento
item.description: Priscila Costa (PL), the councilwoman at the center of the rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro, announced she will not attend the launch of Alcides Fernandes’ pre-candidacy for the Senate in Ceará, stating she is en route to Portugal for a 'conservative women' event. She emphasized having received a mission from Flávio Bolsonaro, son of Jair Bolsonaro, to represent Brazil abroad, reinforcing her alignment with the senator despite internal party conflict over the Senate nomination.

item.title: Mulher trans acusa dono de frigorífico da "Picanha Bolsonaro" de calote e ameaça
item.description: A trans woman identified as Aline* accused Goiás businessman Leandro Batista Nóbrega, owner of Frigorífico Goiás and linked to right-wing figures such as Jair and Flávio Bolsonaro, of transphobia, refusing to pay R$500 for a sexual service, and making threats after an argument. The police report filed at the Specialized Women's Assistance Delegation (Deam) states the encounter occurred on June 15, following contact initiated by the businessman in May 2024, and that Aline recorded the argument after confronting him about transphobic posts on his social media.

item.title: Câmara oficializa perda de mandato dos deputados Paulão e Dayany Bittencourt após decisão do TSE
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies formalized the loss of mandate for federal deputies Paulão (PT-AL) and Dayany Bittencourt (União-CE) following TSE decisions that annulled votes due to campaign irregularities in the 2022 elections. The vote recount led to the replacement of Paulão by Nivaldo Albuquerque (Republicanos-AL) and Dayany by Priscila Costa (PL-CE), without requiring a plenary vote.

item.title: A fúria de Eduardo Bolsonaro que revela o pânico do clã
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro displayed belligerent fury in response to criticisms from federal deputy Zé Trovão, who called Jair Bolsonaro a 'coward' for his silence after the 2022 election defeat and the coup attempt, revealing the clan's internal desperation amid irreconcilable divisions. Meanwhile, PSD president Gilberto Kassab seized the moment to criticize the Bolsonaros, stating they 'have been very wrong,' and suggested that Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy is struggling, stumbling due to the family's own mistakes.

item.title: Quaest divulga nova pesquisa presidencial a partir do dia 15 e traz perguntas sobre Michelle Bolsonaro e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Quaest releases a new presidential poll starting on the 15th, covering first and second-round scenarios for the 2026 elections. The survey includes questions on investigations into Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) over Banco Master ties and the public rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro, assessing their impact on voter perception and Lula’s campaign.

item.title: Pivô da crise 'afaga' Flávio e Michelle em vídeo ao confirmar ausência em ato no Ceará
item.description: Councilwoman Priscila Costa (PL), the focal point of the rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro, confirmed her absence from the Senate candidacy launch event of Alcides Fernandes in Ceará, citing an 'international mission' in Portugal to attend the Conservative Women’s Meeting. In the video, she received praise from Michelle Bolsonaro and was entrusted by Flávio Bolsonaro with a mission tied to defending life and combating abortion, while the PL president in Ceará stated that support for Ciro Gomes is already decided, contradicting Michelle’s position.
